summary: Spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) of two quaternions. Computes the 4-component dot product of a2 and a3; when negative, negates a3 to take the shortest path on the hypersphere. When 1.0 - dot exceeds the 0.02 epsilon, calls FloatFunctionPassThrough (0x005894A0) and blends with sin-based weights (1.0/sin(dot) applied to sin(dot*weight)); otherwise falls through to the linear blend. Writes the interpolated quaternion to this[0..3] (this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC).

local_names.v7: dot product of a2 and a3

operations.description: Compute the 4-component dot product of quaternions a2 and a3: a3[3]*a2[3] + a3[2]*a2[2] + *a2 * *a3 + a3[1]*a2[1]
When the dot product is negative, negate the source quaternion a3 (components v9..v12) and the stored dot value (shortest-path on the hypersphere); otherwise copy a3 unmodified
Compute the weight complement v13 = 1.0 - a4
When 1.0 - dot > 0.02 use full trigonometric SLERP (sin-based weights); otherwise fall through to the linear blend path
Call FloatFunctionPassThrough (0x005894A0) before the sin-based interpolation weights are computed
SLERP weights: v8 = 1.0/sin(dot); v13 = sin(dot*v13)*v8; a4 = sin(dot*a4)*v8
Blend the result quaternion: this[i] = v13 * a2[i] + v_n * a4 for components 0-3, writing this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8, and this+0xC
Void return; called by sub_551210 (0x00551210); the ABI lead name is Quaternion_Spherical_Interpolation
